commitments.detail: Containers C-1, C-2, C-3, and C-4 are assigned to the respective shipment categories as per S1.
Battery modules will be loaded into C-1.
Packaged lubricants will be loaded into C-2.
Clinic coolers will be loaded into C-3.
Boxed repair parts will be loaded into C-4.
Containers will be loaded according to the approved plan.
Containers C-1, C-2, C-3, and C-4 are assigned to transport battery modules, packaged lubricants, clinic coolers, and boxed repair parts respectively.
